rules: Death moves only top-level character-owned item instances to the corpse root.
Contained descendants retain their container location and instance identity.
All descendants of a corpse-root container use null owner while the subtree remains in the corpse.
Looting a corpse-root container assigns the looter as owner of every reachable contained descendant.
Corpse decay recursively removes every reachable descendant before marking the corpse cleaned up.
Recursive transitions execute inside the item engine atomic rollback boundary.
Circular or invalid container hierarchies fail safely and remain visible to validation.

ownership.corpse_descendant: unowned item located in parent container

unknowns: limited-item reservation behavior while in corpses
